quote: We consider the effect of different tokenizations on the semantic correctness of the generated text by testing it on the task of machine translation. We evaluate the performance of the model on WMT16 Czech→English and WMT15 German→English test sets, and report COMET as our primary metric in the main paper. We relegate BLEU and METEOR, along with xCOMET and CometKiwi, to the Appendix for completeness...
